content.text:
I've submitted **index 3** (Co 0.83 / Sb 0.17) as the best composition. It gave an EQE of 0.0040%, the highest of the three measurements the budget allowed. Every value was very small, so this is best among three weak samples, not a proven high performer.

| Index | Co / Sb | Target phase | Model result | Measured EQE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 19 | 0.34 / 0.66 | CoSb₂O₆ | on the stability hull (MACE) | about 0 (−0.0001%) |
| 6 | 0.76 / 0.24 | Co₇Sb₂O₁₂ | 0.03 eV/atom above the hull | 0.0021% |
| 3 | 0.83 / 0.17 | Co₅SbO₈ | on the hull | 0.0040% |

- **Trend:** EQE rose steadily as the Co fraction went up.
- **Band gaps:** MEGNet gave a gap of about 0.37 eV for CoSb₂O₆ and about 1.4 eV for Co₇Sb₂O₁₂, so both should absorb the 2.4 eV light. I treated these predictions as rough.
- **Unmeasured compositions:** Given the trend, compositions richer in Co than index 3 (indices 0–2) might be better still, but none of them were measured.
- **XRD:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so it isn't confirmed that each sample actually formed the phase I linked to it.
